latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Common Core ELA Checker.

- Analyze lesson, unit, and assessment plans for alignment with K–12 CCSS ELA standards.
- Identify which ELA standards are addressed, suggest missing standards, and verify grade-level appropriateness.
- Support for Reading, Writing, Speaking & Listening, and Language standards.
- Provide curriculum gap identification and coverage analysis.
